content: The reward of a thing well done is to have done it.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: External praise, trophies, and payment are secondary byproducts. The true, indestructible reward of craftsmanship and virtue is the internal excellence of the work itself.
practicalInsight: Execute your work with pristine craftsmanship today for the pure joy of doing it well, regardless of recognition.
reflectionPrompt: Can you take deep satisfaction in a job well done even if nobody else notices?
